mentions.name: Sarama
mentions.description: A smart dog collar with AI that understands dog vocalizations. Working capabilities include emotion detection from barks, kennel cough detection, identifying individual dogs from their bark, video analysis of dog behavior, identifying key parts of vocalizations (analogous to phonemes), and basic intent detection (bark translation). The device and companion app are under active development, with plans to port models on-device using MicroPython and TFLite.
